Time series of a performance indicator, with uncertainty ribbons

Source: R/Slick_plots.R
PlotTimeseries.Rd

Plots the median (or mean) and quantile ribbons of a time-series performance indicator for a set of MPs, using Slick::plotTimeseries(). The MPs can be split into groups, with one panel per group and the MPs of each group shown together with ribbons in the colour of each MP (e.g. one panel per HCR, with one line and ribbon per CMP type), or shown with one panel per OM.

Usage

PlotTimeseries(
  slick,
  PI = 1,
  MPs = NULL,
  OMs = 1,
  groups = NULL,
  byOM = FALSE,
  MP_labels = NULL,
  MP_colors = NULL,
  MeanMed = "median",
  quants1 = c(0.25, 0.75),
  quants2 = c(0.05, 0.95),
  alpha1 = 0.35,
  alpha2 = 0.15,
  ref_year = NULL,
  ref_lines = NULL,
  ref_color = "#e34948",
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  ncol = 2,
  strip_width = 30,
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_title = NULL,
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "serif",
  ...
)

Arguments

slick

A Slick object.

PI

Index or code of the time-series performance indicator.

MPs

Codes or indices of the MPs to plot. Defaults to all.

OMs

Codes or indices of the OMs. Values are pooled over the OMs unless byOM = TRUE. Defaults to the first OM.

groups

Optional named list of MP codes; one panel per group.

byOM

Logical. One panel per OM?

MP_labels

Optional labels of the MPs (named by MP code), shown in the legend.

MP_colors

Optional colours of the MPs (named by MP code).

MeanMed

'median' or 'mean'.

quants1, quants2

Quantiles of the inner and outer ribbons.

alpha1, alpha2

Transparency of the inner and outer ribbons.

ref_year

Optional year of the first management advice (vertical line).

ref_lines

Optional named numeric vector of horizontal reference lines.

ref_color

Colour of the reference lines.

xlim, ylim

Optional axis limits.

ylab

Optional y-axis label. Defaults to the label of the PI.

ncol

Number of columns of panels.

strip_width

Width (characters) at which the OM names are wrapped when byOM = TRUE.

legend

Logical. Show the MP legend? (e.g. FALSE when the panel titles name the MPs)

legend_title

Title of the legend.

base_size, base_family

Passed to theme_slick_print().

...

Other arguments passed to Slick::plotTimeseries().

Value

A ggplot2 object, or a patchwork object if groups is used.
